svg.title: Where the speed comes from
svg.desc: Tokens per second with 8 requests at once, Qwen3.5-4B on an M2 Pro, each part of Locals switched off on its own: Locals 272.7; Locals' model on mlx-lm's scheduler 272.9; without the Gated DeltaNet kernel 267.6; without fused projections 246.8; without pipelining 236.5; without the small-batch kernels 119.2; in bfloat16 instead of float16 97.9; everything above off 79.3; plain mlx-lm 86.2.
